loss: native MSE + finite-effect MSE, both normalized by native-output energy. No output-weight penalty; explicit Frobenius gain budget enforced after every step.
controls: Same512 states/interventions, minibatches per initialization seed,4 products, same optimizer and steps. Free factors unitnorm; hull factors native convex combinations with norm<=1; normalized-state only optimizationcontrol. State and difference anchors rescaled to unit RMS norm separately using training data. Raw bank scales saved. Two independent128-anchor banks crossed with two initializations. Free has no anchors and is trained once per seed/budget.
limits: Parameter counts differ (hull logits vs free factors), not convergence proof. Known teacher rank supplied. No claim that hull constraint fixes gauge or means same geometry as A-SAE. Anchored banks all span16D; their scale affects effective gain constraints.
